Recommended Highlights This Week

1. Orchard Road Christmas Light-Up – Tuesday 17 November, 7:00pm, Shaw House Urban Plaza

2. Singapore v Brazil and Japan v Paraguay – Tuesday 17 November, National Stadium

3. Joji: SOLARIS – 21 and 22 November, Arena @ EXPO

4. Singapore Writers Festival – through Sunday 22 November, Civic District

5. Christmas Train Show – opens Friday 20 November, Flower Dome, Gardens by the Bay

F&B Promotions

Current dining promotions across our Shangri-La Group properties in Singapore:

Shangri-La Singapore

The Line and The Rose Veranda move to their festive offerings this week, from 18 and 19 November. Shang Palace's Golden Autumn Hairy Crab menu continues to 30 November, and Waterfall Ristorante Italiano's White Truffle Season continues to 20 December.

  • The Line – Festive Buffet, 18 November to 23 December 2026. Lunch $78++/adult, $39++/child (6–11 years); dinner $108++/adult, $54++/child (6–11 years). Inclusive of chilled juices.

  • Shang Palace – Golden Autumn Hairy Crab, 15 October to 30 November 2026. Hairy crabs from Tai Hu Lake. Menu and pricing are confirmed with the restaurant directly (ext. 7460).

  • Waterfall Ristorante Italiano – White Truffle Season, 10 November to 20 December 2026. The regular menu is also available.

  • The Rose Veranda – Festive High Tea buffet, 19 November to 23 December 2026, Thursday to Sunday. $58++/adult, $29++/child (6–11 years), inclusive of coffee and tea. Two seatings: 12:00pm–2:30pm and 3:00pm–5:30pm.

  • Origin Grill – The Meat Series: The Art of Aged Beef, Thursday 19 November 2026. $98++ per person, minimum two guests: a starter, four cuts of meat served sharing style, and dessert.

  • Beng Hiang – Authentic Hokkien cuisine at the Garden Terrace. Lunch 11:30am–2:30pm; dinner 6:00pm–9:30pm, daily.

Coming Up at Shangri-La Singapore

  • Origin Grill – The Meat Series returns on 17 December 2026, $98++ per person.

  • The Rose Veranda – open daily from 3 to 31 December 2026 (Thursday to Sunday only until then).

Shangri-La Rasa Sentosa

  • Rasa Private Beach BBQ – SGD 188++ per package (2 adults + 2 children). Valid through 31 December 2026.

  • Silver Shell Cafe – international dinner buffet from $85++/adult on weekdays, with a higher weekend rate. Themed nights: Singapore Good Ol' Days (Wednesday and Sunday) and Seafood Sensation (Friday and Saturday).

Hotel Jen Tanglin

  • J65 – International Seafood Dinner Buffet. $88++/adult, $44++/child. Shangri-La Circle members: 20% off. Halal-certified. Must-try: lobster dishes on Wednesday Lobster Rock & Roll night (grilled lobster, lobster thermidor, lobster laksa), Singapore chilli crab with mantou, Hainanese chicken rice.

Hotel Jen Orchard Gateway

  • Makan@JEN – daily lunch and dinner buffet, $30–55++ per person. 15% off for OCBC cardmembers, ongoing. Must-try: Beef Rendang.

Events & Festivals

Overall Summary

A week that moves from football to the first Christmas lights of the season. On Tuesday 17 November, Singapore host Brazil and Japan face Paraguay at the National Stadium, and Orchard Road switches on its Christmas lights at 7:00pm. 5 Seconds of Summer play The Star Theatre on Monday, Joji plays Arena @ EXPO on Saturday and Sunday, and Simple Plan close the week at the Singapore Indoor Stadium on Sunday. The Singapore Writers Festival runs through Sunday, and the Christmas Train Show opens at Gardens by the Bay on Friday 20 November.

Orchard Road Christmas Light-Up

Orchard Road opens its Christmas season with a light-up ceremony at Shaw House Urban Plaza. The 6.2-metre Merli on top of Shaw House is lit nightly, and a 3D projection show runs on the façade of Hilton Singapore Orchard.

Event Date: Light-up ceremony on Tuesday 17 November 2026, 7:00pm; Christmas on A Great Street runs through 3 January 2027. 3D projection show nightly 7:00pm–10:00pm
Location: Shaw House Urban Plaza, corner of Orchard Road and Scotts Road; projection show at Hilton Singapore Orchard
Admission: Free to view along Orchard Road
Best For: All Guests / Families / Photographers

Concierge Recommendation: The ceremony starts at 7:00pm, so guests should arrive well before then, and Orchard MRT is the closest station. The lights stay on until 3 January, so guests who prefer to avoid the opening-night crowd can see them on a later evening.

Mizuho Blue Challenge – The Kallang Football Series: Singapore v Brazil, Japan v Paraguay

The series closes with a double-header at the National Stadium. Singapore host Brazil, followed by Japan against Paraguay.

Event Date: Tuesday 17 November 2026. Doors 4:00pm; Singapore v Brazil kick-off 6:00pm; Japan v Paraguay kick-off 9:10pm
Location: National Stadium, Singapore Sports Hub
Admission: Ticketed via Ticketmaster Singapore, $98 to $268 by category, VIP $888, before booking fees
Best For: Football Fans / Groups / Corporate Guests

Concierge Recommendation: A long evening at the stadium, with doors opening at 4:00pm and the second match starting at 9:10pm. Advise guests to allow extra time around the Sports Hub, and to pre-book return transport, since ride-hailing demand will be high when the second match ends.

5 Seconds of Summer: Everyone’s A Star! World Tour

The Australian pop-rock band play The Star Theatre on Monday evening. A second Singapore show follows on 3 December.

Event Date: Monday 16 November 2026, 8:00pm
Location: The Star Theatre, The Star Performing Arts Centre, 1 Vista Exchange Green, Singapore 138617
Admission: Ticketed via Ticketmaster Singapore, from $148 before booking fees. Guests aged 6 and above need a ticket. Photography, video and live streaming are not allowed
Best For: Pop-Rock Fans / Young Groups

Concierge Recommendation: The Star Theatre is a short walk from Buona Vista MRT. Taxi and ride-hailing queues build quickly after the show, so return transport is best arranged in advance.

Joji: SOLARIS

Joji brings his SOLARIS tour to Singapore for two nights at Arena @ EXPO.

Event Date: Saturday 21 and Sunday 22 November 2026, 8:00pm
Location: Arena @ EXPO, Singapore EXPO
Admission: Ticketed via Ticketmaster Singapore, Category 3 from $178 and VIP standing $358, before booking fees. Children need their own ticket; infants in arms are not admitted
Best For: Joji Fans / Young Groups

Concierge Recommendation: Guests should allow extra time for security screening on arrival. On Sunday 22 November, Simple Plan also play the Singapore Indoor Stadium at 8:00pm, so expect higher ride-hailing demand across the city that evening.

Simple Plan: The Bigger Than You Think! Tour

The Canadian pop-punk band close the week at the Singapore Indoor Stadium.

Event Date: Sunday 22 November 2026, doors 6:00pm, show 8:00pm
Location: Singapore Indoor Stadium, Singapore Sports Hub, 2 Stadium Walk, Singapore 397691
Admission: Ticketed via SISTIC, $98 to $148 by category. Children under 12 are not admitted; children under 16, or under 1.2m, are not allowed in the standing areas
Best For: Pop-Punk Fans / Groups

Concierge Recommendation: Guests should leave the hotel by 5:30pm for the 6:00pm doors. Stadium MRT is a short walk from the venue, and ride-hailing demand is high at the end of the show, so a pre-booked car is the safer return.

Singapore Writers Festival 2026: Hidden in Plain Sight

This year’s festival has a special focus on crime and mystery. Programmes are held across the Civic District and at other venues around the city.

Event Date: Through Sunday 22 November 2026 (festival runs 13 to 22 November)
Location: The Arts House at the Old Parliament, National Gallery Singapore, Asian Civilisations Museum and Victoria Concert Hall, among other venues
Admission: Festival and Youth Passes $15 to $30; pass holders receive 15% off individually ticketed events. Some programmes are free, including Book Doctor on 22 November, 1:30pm–2:30pm, with registration
Best For: Book Lovers / Culture-Minded Guests / Families

Concierge Recommendation: The main venues are all in the Civic District, so the festival combines easily with Sacred Caves at the Asian Civilisations Museum and Fan Chang Tien at the National Gallery. Entry to many sessions is first come, first served, so guests should check the programme for the session they want.

Christmas Train Show 2026

The Christmas Train Show is staged in the Flower Dome at Gardens by the Bay and is included in Flower Dome admission.

Event Date: Opens Friday 20 November 2026; daily through 3 January 2027, 9:00am–9:00pm (last admission 8:30pm)
Location: Flower Dome, Gardens by the Bay, 18 Marina Gardens Drive, Singapore 018953
Admission: No separate ticket. Residents: Flower Dome $12 adult, $8 child (3–12); Flower Dome and Cloud Forest $34 adult, $26 child. Non-residents: Flower Dome and Cloud Forest $46 adult, $32 child
Best For: Families / Festive-Season Visitors / Photography

Concierge Recommendation: A good daytime or early-evening outing for families. A section of the Flower Field is closed from 1:00pm to 2:15pm on opening day, and the Flower Dome has a maintenance closure on Monday 16 November.

Continuing This Week

These exhibitions remain open through the coming days.

Sacred Caves: Dunhuang, Buddhism, and the Silk Road – Asian Civilisations Museum, 1 Empress Place. Through 7 March 2027, daily 10:00am–7:00pm; Fridays until 9:00pm. All-access ticket required.
Fan Chang Tien: Rhythm of the Southern Brush – Wu Guanzhong Gallery, Level 4, City Hall Wing, National Gallery Singapore. Through 31 January 2027, daily 10:00am–7:00pm. General Admission ticket required; free for Singapore citizens and PRs.

Concierge Recommendation: Sacred Caves and Fan Chang Tien pair well on a Civic District day, alongside the Singapore Writers Festival.

Also This Week

  • Disney Garden of Wonder – Floral Fantasy, Gardens by the Bay. Daily 10:00am–9:00pm (last admission 8:30pm), through 14 March 2027. Non-residents $24 adult, $16 child.

  • Jurassic World: The Experience – Cloud Forest, Gardens by the Bay. Daily 9:00am–9:00pm. Non-residents $46 adult, $32 child, including Flower Dome.

  • Singapore International Photography Festival, 10th edition – exhibitions at Lorong 24 Geylang and SingPost Geylang, through 31 January 2027. Festival Pass $50 ($40 concession); single venues $15 to $20.

  • Dopamine Land Singapore – 1 November to 31 December 2026, tickets from SGD 22.

  • Toy Story High Tea at SKAI – through 30 November 2026.

  • Horizon of Khufu: Journey in Ancient Egypt – Parkview Square, 600 North Bridge Road. A VR experience, daily 10:00am–6:00pm, until 2 April 2027. $35 adult, $29 child under 8.

  • Singapore History Gallery – National Museum of Singapore. The reopened permanent gallery is open daily, 10:00am–7:00pm.

Restaurants & Bars

JJAN!

A Korean tapas bar on Craig Road in Tanjong Pagar, serving raw seafood, jeon and rice dishes alongside a list of more than 30 makgeolli.

Location: 45 Craig Road, Singapore 089683
Hours: Monday to Friday 5:00pm–12:00am; Saturday and Sunday 1:00pm–12:00am
Opened: 12 November 2026
Signature: Squid Ganghoe, $6++ per piece; Pyogo Jeon, $5++ per piece; Busan Jijimi & Squid Salad, $19++; Deep-Fried Oyster Ssam, $22++; Yukhoe, $34++; Pork Gukbap, $21++; Wagyu Beef Tongue, $58++; Midam Seoktanju, $19++; Suamju, $18++
Note: Not halal-certified

Concierge Recommendation: A relaxed evening option in Tanjong Pagar for guests who want Korean small plates and makgeolli. The late closing time also makes it a useful after-dinner stop.

Hando

A modern izakaya on Cavan Road with made-to-order handrolls, alongside Japanese izakaya dishes.

Location: 28 Cavan Road, Singapore 209855
Hours: Daily 12:00pm–2:15pm and 6:00pm–9:00pm
Opened: Soft launch on 30 October 2026
Signature: Tai handroll, from $8++; Uni Bomb handroll, $28++; Seared Anago handroll, $10++; Engawa handroll, $10++; The HAND-Some One set (five rolls), $45++; The Full HANDO set (seven rolls), $78++; Quick HANDO lunch set (three rolls, miso, pickles, cold tea), $28++
Note: Not halal-certified

Concierge Recommendation: A light, quick lunch or early dinner for guests who enjoy Japanese food. The kitchen closes at 9:00pm, so evening guests should arrive early.

Osteria Da Su

A casual Italian restaurant on Telok Ayer Street with a Korean accent, led by Korea-born chef Suji Park, who has cooked Italian food for close to 20 years. Opening week was dinner only; lunch service begins on Monday 16 November.

Location: 163 Telok Ayer Street, Singapore 068616
Hours: Monday to Saturday, lunch and dinner from 16 November 2026
Opened: 23 October 2026
Signature: Spaghetti alle vongole, $28++; Tortelli di galbi jjim, $30++; Farfalle all’amatriciana, $24++; Korean pepper fritto, $14++; Dalgona tiramisu, $14++
Reservations: bit.ly/dasu
Note: Not halal-certified

Concierge Recommendation: A good choice for guests who want something different from a standard Italian meal. Lunch is now available on weekdays and Saturdays, which suits guests exploring the Telok Ayer and CBD area.

Hotel & Hospitality News

No new hotel openings or leadership appointments to report this week.

Transport & Operational Updates

Overnight works affect several expressways this week, mostly between 12:00am and 5:00am. The Sentosa Gateway Tunnel slip roads to Lower Delta Road and Keppel Road are closed on Monday 16 November for tunnel washing. The BKE (PIE) Exit 3 slip road to Bukit Panjang Road is closed from 1:00am on 16 and 17 November. Woodsville Tunnel closes from 12:01am to 5:00am between Tuesday 17 and Friday 20 November. The Serangoon Road to CTE (City) slip road is closed from 1:00am to 5:00am on 18 to 20 November, and the PIE (Tuas) Exit 12 slip road to KPE (ECP) is closed from 12:00am to 5:00am on 19 to 21 November. Lentor Avenue and Sembawang Road close nightly from 1:30am to 5:30am through 30 November, and the TPE and PIE slip roads to Tampines Avenue 7 and Loyang Avenue close from 10:00pm to 5:30am through 30 November.

Weekend road closures to note: Holland Village is fully closed Friday to Sunday, 6:30pm to 2:30am; Liang Seah Street is closed Friday to Sunday, 6:30pm to 12:00am; and Circular Road is closed on Friday and Saturday, 7:00pm to 3:00am. In Little India, Lembu Road, Kerbau Road, Chander Road, Dunlop Street and Birch Road are closed on Sunday 22 November from 12:00pm to 12:00am.

Expect higher road and ride-hailing demand around Orchard Road from the evening of Tuesday 17 November for the Christmas light-up, and around the National Stadium for the football double-header the same evening. On Saturday 21 and Sunday 22 November, Arena @ EXPO hosts Joji at 8:00pm, and on Sunday the Singapore Indoor Stadium hosts Simple Plan at 8:00pm. The Star Theatre has 5 Seconds of Summer at 8:00pm on Monday 16 November.

Suggested Itineraries

Christmas Lights on Orchard Road

Afternoon: Take an early dinner on Orchard Road, before the crowds gather around Shaw House.

Evening: The light-up ceremony begins at 7:00pm at Shaw House Urban Plaza. The 3D projection show on the façade of Hilton Singapore Orchard then runs until 10:00pm.

Tip: Travel by MRT to Orchard station. The lights stay on until 3 January 2027, so guests who prefer a quieter visit can return on a later evening.

A Civic District Culture Day

Morning: Choose a session at the Singapore Writers Festival at The Arts House or the National Gallery, checking the programme first.

Afternoon: Visit Sacred Caves at the Asian Civilisations Museum, then walk to Fan Chang Tien at the National Gallery Singapore, open daily until 7:00pm.

Evening: Dinner at Shang Palace for the Golden Autumn Hairy Crab menu, which runs to 30 November.

Tip: On Friday the Asian Civilisations Museum stays open until 9:00pm, so the museum can be left until the evening if guests prefer.

A Festive Weekend at Gardens by the Bay

Afternoon: The Christmas Train Show at the Flower Dome, with Cloud Forest on the same ticket for non-residents.

Evening: Dinner at The Line, with the Festive Buffet at $108++ per adult.

Tip: On Sunday 22 November, Joji and Simple Plan both play at 8:00pm, so guests heading out after dinner should have return transport booked.

Quick Reference

Best Festive Evening: Orchard Road Christmas Light-Up (Shaw House Urban Plaza, Tuesday 17 November, 7:00pm)

Best Sporting Evening: Singapore v Brazil and Japan v Paraguay (National Stadium, Tuesday 17 November)

Best Concert This Week: Joji: SOLARIS (Arena @ EXPO, 21 and 22 November)

Best Exhibition: Sacred Caves (Asian Civilisations Museum, through 7 March 2027)

Best Family Pick: Christmas Train Show (Flower Dome, from 20 November)

Best Hotel Dining Pick: Festive Buffet at The Line (from 18 November)

Best New Opening: JJAN! (45 Craig Road, opened 12 November)

Looking Ahead: Lost & Found: How We Remember opens at the Singapore Art Museum on 27 November; 5 Seconds of Summer return to The Star Theatre on 3 December; Origin Grill Meat Series on 17 December; Orchard Road Christmas Eve street party on 24 December
